perspective:
Angela’s available information:

- She knows Kevin is her close friend since high school; they confide in each other. She knows he works as a construction worker.
- She noticed Kevin seemed unhappy with his job, so she invited him to coffee to talk.
- At coffee, she heard Kevin say he was “alright” but that work was the “usual grind.” He then said he was not happy, felt stuck and unfulfilled, and was just going through the motions. He said he had thought about changing jobs/careers but felt overwhelmed and did not know where to start. Angela suggested figuring it out together and looking into options; Kevin thanked her and agreed.
- Later, Angela found job openings and a career counseling service and told Kevin about them. Kevin thanked her and said he had been thinking about something more creative, possibly design or architecture. Angela encouraged him and suggested checking the resources. She believed he was considering a career change and felt supportive and hopeful.
- Angela then believed Kevin was hesitant and felt frustrated and worried. She arranged a meeting with a career coach and told him. Kevin said she did not have to, appreciated it, but was not sure he was ready. Angela encouraged him; he agreed to give it a shot. She promised to support him.
- Later, Angela believed Kevin was making progress and felt proud and relieved. She asked how things were going with the career coach. Kevin told her the coach was helpful, he had started online design courses, and he felt more confident. She offered more help; Kevin said her support was enough and he would tell her if he needed anything.
- Angela believed Kevin had successfully transitioned to a new career and felt happy and satisfied. She organized a small celebration party and told him. Kevin thanked her and said he was grateful and could not have done it without her. Angela said he did the hard work and invited him to enjoy the party.

Angela does not have direct access to Kevin’s private thoughts, his coaching sessions, his courses, or his actual job transition except as Kevin told her or as she believed/inferred.
